note: The single source for the 11 canonical harness components and their picks. /c, /c/[component], /stack and /api/stack all read this file, so the shelves and the recommended stack can never disagree. Deliberately holds NO score: a pick's Score and Signals are resolved live from lib/rank.mjs by armoryName, so a re-rank can never leave a stale number here. A pick whose armoryName is null is not a catalog row and renders as Not Indexed — never faked into the table.
